headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self' data:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

responseRules.Rule: ((http.host eq "chosenecho.top" or http.host eq "studynote.chosenecho.top") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/courses/operating-systems/figures/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/courses/computer-organization/figures/")) and http.referer contains "://" and not (http.referer contains "://chosenecho.top/") and not (http.referer contains "://studynote.chosenecho.top/"))

((http.host eq "chosenecho.top" or http.host eq "studynote.chosenecho.top") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.env") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.git") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-admin") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-login.php") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/xmlrpc.php") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/phpmyadmin") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/vendor/phpunit/")))

cacheRules.Rule: ((http.host eq "chosenecho.top" or http.host eq "studynote.chosenecho.top") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/acme-challenge/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/__release.json"))
